title: Refresh: CPS-v3 Recovery Decay (ingest R2@+10) + Panel/Indexes
abstract: Recompute CPS‑v3 recovery decay for Zephyr IV after R2@+10, export v3 panel, update bundle/panels indexes, and refresh dashboard_state.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.recovery_decay_analysis import compute_recovery_decay
from meta.sas.tools.export_recovery_decay_panel import export_panel
from meta.sas.tools.update_bundle_index import update as update_index
from meta.sas.tools.export_panels_index import export_panels_index
try:
  from meta.sas.tools.export_dashboard_state import export_dashboard_state
except Exception:
  export_dashboard_state = None

derived_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json'
panel_path   = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/recovery_decay_zephyr_iv_v3.json'

out = {}
out['derived'] = compute_recovery_decay(
  agent='Zephyr IV',
  dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
  out_path=derived_path,
  experiments=['cps_v3']
)
out['panel'] = export_panel(in_path=derived_path, out_path=panel_path)
out['bundle_index'] = update_index()
out['panels_index'] = export_panels_index()
out['dashboard_state'] = export_dashboard_state() if export_dashboard_state else {"skipped": True}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
